note: The only campground in Wind Cave National Park, on the edge of ponderosa pine and open prairie about 1 mi north of the visitor center. Loop A (sites 1-14) is tent-only; RV sites are in loops B-D, about 34 of them 23 ft or longer, and many B-loop sites are parallel pull-offs along the road. Generators are not allowed in sites 1-15 and run 8 am-8 pm elsewhere. --Claude
summary: rec.gov facility/rates/catalog + NPS API/page + imagery: open year-round (off-season B loop 15-35 only, no water, half price), $24 peak / $12 off-peak, reservation-only on rec.gov (same-day ok), 45 RV-permitted sites (34 at 23 ft+), 36 ft max; no hookups/showers/dump. All derived groups now manual; fees seasonal added; note rewritten.
